```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

options(scipen = 999)

space_heating_data <- file_check |> 
  janitor::clean_names()

#connect to data warehouse
db <- RPostgreSQL::dbConnect(RPostgreSQL::PostgreSQL(),
                 dbname = dbname, 
                 host = host, 
                 port = port, 
                 user = user, 
                 password = password)

```

```{sql connection=db, echo = FALSE, output.var = "utility_table"}

SELECT DISTINCT utility_name, mn_utility_id AS utility_id
FROM energy.utility_info 

```

Check for duplicate entries

```{r, echo = FALSE}

dup_check <- space_heating_data |>
  dplyr::mutate(row_id = paste(utility_id, as.character(report_year), sep = "_")) |>
  dplyr::group_by(row_id) |>
  dplyr::mutate(count = dplyr::n()) |>
  dplyr::filter(count > 1)

if(nrow(dup_check) == 0){

  print("No duplicates found")

} else{

  print("The following rows are duplicates")

  DT::datatable(dup_check)

}
  
```

NEED TO EDIT WHEN DATA WAREHOUSE OUT
These utility county values have fluctuated 20% or more compared to the average over the last 3 years.

```{sql connection=db, echo = FALSE, output.var = "space_heating_avg"}
WITH years_use AS(
  SELECT DISTINCT report_year
  FROM energy.all_space_heating
  ORDER BY report_year DESC
  LIMIT 3
)
SELECT TO_CHAR(utility_id, 'FM9999') AS utility_id, AVG(mwh_delivered) AS mwh_avg
FROM energy.all_space_heating
WHERE report_year IN (SELECT report_year FROM years_use)
GROUP BY utility, utility_id
ORDER BY utility
```

```{r, echo = FALSE}

mwh_check <- space_heating_data |> 
  dplyr::filter(mwh_delivered != 0 & is.na(mwh_delivered) == FALSE) |> 
  dplyr::left_join(space_heating_avg, by = c("utility_id" = "utility_id")) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(percent_diff = (mwh_delivered / mwh_avg) - 1) |> 
  dplyr::filter(abs(percent_diff) >= .2)

DT::datatable(mwh_check)

```
